t.zh: 把一张图放大或缩小，新图的每个像素都要有一个值；算值之前，先得知道它落在原图的哪里。约定是：原图第 x 个像素是一个宽 1 的格子，中心在 x，占 x − 0.5 到 x + 0.5；新图的像素平分原图这一整段长度。
t.en: Enlarging or shrinking an image gives every pixel of the new image a value; before any value, each must know where it sits in the original. The convention: pixel x of the original is a cell 1 wide, centred on x, spanning x − 0.5 to x + 0.5; the new pixels share the original's whole length equally.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：缩放时，新图的每个像素落在原图的哪里？第一个任务在格子上手算一行，可以填分数（如 −1/6）；第二个任务接一块电路，交出整张新图的两张源坐标图，测试的坐标都对才算对。
t.en: This level asks: when an image is resized, where in the original does each new pixel sit? The first task works out one row by hand on the grid, fractions welcome (−1/6); the second wires a circuit that gives the whole new image's two source-coordinate images, right when every tested coordinate is.

desc.zh: 输入原图的宽 sw、高 sh 和新图的宽 nw、高 nh，输出新图每个像素在原图里的 x、y（两张坐标图）
desc.en: Takes the original's width sw and height sh and the new width nw and height nh; gives each new pixel's x and y in the original (two coordinate images)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>：每个新像素反向映射回原图，落点一般不在旧像素的中心上，常在两个旧像素之间。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>: each new pixel mapped back into the original, landing seldom on an old pixel's centre and often between two.

brief.zh: 原图这一行 2 个像素，占 −0.5 到 1.5，长 2。放大成 3 个像素，三个新像素平分这段长度：写出每个新像素中心的 x。可以填分数，如 1/3。
brief.en: This row of 2 pixels spans −0.5 to 1.5, a length of 2. Enlarged to 3 pixels, the three new ones share that length equally: write the x of each new pixel's centre. Fractions are fine, such as 1/3.

hint.zh: 每个新像素宽多少？第一个从 −0.5 开始，它的中心在哪里？
hint.en: How wide is each new pixel? The first starts at −0.5: where is its centre?

hint.zh: 中间那个新像素的中心，正好在整段的正中。
hint.en: The middle new pixel's centre is right in the middle of the whole length.

after.zh: 新像素不是旧像素换了编号：中间那个落在两个旧像素之间。
after.en: New pixels are not old ones renumbered: the middle one falls between two old pixels.

label.zh: 新像素中心在原图里的 x
label.en: x of each new pixel's centre in the original

why.zh: 这是把新像素当成旧像素重新编号：原图这一行只有 x = 0 和 x = 1 两个像素，x = 2 落在原图外面。新旧两排一样长，三个新像素中心要分布在两个旧像素占的那段长度上。
why.en: That renumbers the new pixels as if they were old ones: the original row has pixels at x = 0 and x = 1 only, so x = 2 lies outside it. The two rows are equally long, so the three new centres spread over the length the two old pixels cover.

t.zh: 手算一行可以，一整张图要每个像素各算一遍，就要电路了：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去。新图的每个像素先要有自己的坐标，而手上没有元件能从两个数造出一整张图。
t.en: One row works by hand; a whole image, every pixel worked out, needs a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right. Each new pixel first needs its own coordinates, and nothing in hand makes a whole image out of two numbers.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>给定宽和高，给出每格就是自己 x、y 的两张坐标图。坐标还要换算：<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数，<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>对数和整张图逐个值地算。
t.en: The new part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref> takes a width and a height and gives the two coordinate images whose cells hold their own x and y. The coordinates still need converting: <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number, and <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>, <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref> work value by value on numbers and whole images.

brief.zh: 输入原图和新图的宽高：交出新图每个像素在原图里的 x 坐标图和 y 坐标图。
brief.en: Given the original's and the new width and height, give the image of each new pixel's x in the original, and the image of its y.

hint.zh: 先给新图的每个像素一对它自己的坐标。
hint.en: First give every pixel of the new image its own pair of coordinates.

hint.zh: 新图的一个像素宽，相当于原图的几个像素宽？像素中心和像素左边差多少？
hint.en: One pixel of the new image is how many pixels of the original wide? How far is a pixel's centre from its left edge?
